card

components · 0.2.0 · F2 · aj-c-card

A static card: a printed heading, one or more paragraphs in the product's voice, and an optional row of actions. Human-written, never generated; never colour-coded, never alarming. Today it carries the delete-everything confirmation inside the dialog.
